interpretation: The GetGuardianFeed sample is one authenticated, account- and request-context-specific HTTP 200 observation, not a universal response contract.

Observed primitive types are sample metadata only. They do not prove requiredness, accepted values, enums, nullability, completeness, stable identifiers, or behavior for other accounts, roles, dates, and feed variants.
Empty arrays reveal no item shape. Missing sample fields do not invalidate independently supported optional static client-read paths.
The capture envelope is not the response body: status and content-type metadata are excluded from all body paths below.
No raw values, actual dates, diary text, names, or identifiers are included. The continuation field is observed but no pagination or accepted-cursor semantics are inferred.

modelPathComparison.note: Paths absent from this one response remain legitimate optional static-only observations. In particular, the observed status.meals is distinct from the unobserved diary-entry meals path; no diary-entry total_time value was observed. Empty feedback/text/evaluation arrays do not test their item paths.

candidateDisposition.recommendation: Keep the response body rooted at data and next_date, consistent with the existing service-to-callback-to-reducer trace. Add the sample paths/types above as non-normative observation metadata only; retain the existing partial static model and its unknown primitive types, open objects, and optional fields.
doNotInfer: Do not claim data-group contents are owned by the explicitly selected child; the generic explicit child-ID boundary comparison had zero mismatches, but the unlabelled response groups do not establish ownership or guarantee exclusively private content.
Do not claim that feedback is visible to this guardian or that the endpoint exposes feedback generally; all observed feedback arrays were empty.

Do not infer a schema for texts, feedback, or evaluations items from empty arrays. The client static check for texts admits arrays and must remain unknown rather than being narrowed to a dictionary or this sample's array type.
Do not reinterpret status fields, status.meals, IDs, timestamps, null updated_by, or the next_date value; the sample establishes types only.
Do not remove static-only diary-entry meals, total_time, summaries, images, documents, feedback item, or likes paths because they were absent or uninspectable in this sample.
Do not infer pagination rules, date meaning/timezone, guaranteed group or item counts, publication behavior, server authorization, or response completeness.
